title: Generator-normalized scalar-extension evaluation comparison
statement: Let J be an essentially small site with coefficients in max(c,v,r), and let B,tau and D,sigma be inverse sequences of commutative ring sheaves. Let phi be a morphism of the corresponding ring systems with component alpha_n : B_n to D_n at each (n,U), let S be ScalarData for phi, let M be a B-system, and fix n [def-coef-semilinear-system-models]. There is an isomorphism changeOfRings(alpha_n, evaluation_n(M)) to evaluation_n(S.model.E(M)). Its morphism sends extensionUnit(alpha_n, evaluation_n(M), U, x) to scalarExtensionSection(phi,S,M,(n,U),x) on every section. The equation fixes its value on the locally generating tensors.

proof.text: Apply the presheaf comparison [lem-sp-scalar-extension-evaluation-presheaf]. The vertical inclusion is continuous and cocontinuous. Compose the sheafification of that presheaf isomorphism with restrictionSheafificationMap and the evaluated object equality S.model.obj_eq. Naturality of the sheafification unit, the pure-tensor equation, and restrictionSheafificationMap_unit_apply give the section formula.

theorem scalarExtension_evaluation_comparison
    {C : Type c} [Category.{v} C] [EssentiallySmall.{max c v r} C]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    (B D : ℕ → Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c v r})
    (τ : ∀ n, B (n + 1) ⟶ B n) (σ : ∀ n, D (n + 1) ⟶ D n)
    (α : ∀ n, B n ⟶ D n)
    (φ : systemRing.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ ⟶ systemRing.{c, v, max c v r} J D σ)
    (hφ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Cᵒᵖ), φ.hom.app (op (n, U.unop)) = (α n).hom.app U)
    (S : ScalarData.{c, v, max c v r} φ)
    (M : Systems.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ e : SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{v, c, max c v r} (α n)
        ((evaluation.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ n).obj M) ≅
          (evaluation.{c, v, max c v r} J D σ n).obj (S.model.E.obj M),
      ∀ (U : Cᵒᵖ) (x : M.val.obj (op (n, U.unop))),
        e.hom.val.app U (extensionUnit.{c, v, max c v r} (α n)
          ((evaluation.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ n).obj M) U x) =
        scalarExtensionSection.{c, v, r}
          φ S M (op (n, U.unop)) x
